title: lunasia quercifolia
intro: Lunasia quercifolia, commonly known as Lunasia, is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae, native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lunasia quercifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and limonoids, which exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic potential of Lunasia quercifolia.
